description: skills.sh is a directory and leaderboard for reusable AI-agent skills, with pages for browsing, packs, audits, and documentation. It indexes skills from repositories and other sources and provides installation workflows for agent tooling.
summary: skills.sh exposes an authenticated HTTP catalog API at `https://skills.sh/api/v1` using Vercel OIDC tokens, plus a public `skills` CLI distributed via npm/npx.
